hooks.command: bash -c "FILE=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | python -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"file_path\",d.get(\"path\",\"\")))' 2>/dev/null || echo 'SAFE'); for p in '.env' 'application-prod.properties' 'application-staging.properties'; do case \"$FILE\" in *$p*) echo \"BLOCKED: $p is protected\" >&2; exit 2;; esac; done; exit 0"
